Account snapshot: Ridgeway AI Assurance — mid-market insurtech focused on automated underwriting and first-notice-of-loss triage. Strong product/ML team but lean infra org. Key decision-maker: Head of Digital Products (Maya Chen). Internal champion (Sr. ML Eng) is on hiring hold; unlikely to be replaced until at least Q4.

POC summary: Two-week evaluation running on a small dedicated cluster. Results: embeddings-based similarity performed well for historical claims retrieval; generative summarization hit p95 ~120-160ms on test traces with 8k context (SE notes: can improve with batching/quantization). Cost profile was higher than incumbent because Ridgeway was targeting on-prem/EU residency.

Security & compliance: Ridgeway requires SOC2 + SSO/SAML + KMS integration and explicit EU data residency for policy reasons. Security team requested architecture diagram, threat model, and a short term list of mitigations. We provided security FAQ and a reference architecture (see drive links).

Status update from 2026-02-25 call: "We love the tech but hiring is frozen and budget lines are closed for Q2 — we can't proceed with headcount or capital spend." — Maya Chen. They asked for a hosted, pay-as-you-go option with constrained retention as a cheaper alternative.

- Provide a deferred commercial cadence: check-in in 6–8 weeks after budget review window.
- Keep SE engaged to produce a 1‑pager quantization/batch plan to drop cost 30–40%.
- Convert security asks into a short checklist (deliverable) to keep S3/evidence trail warm.

- No strong internal champion at exec level (Maya is supportive but blocked by finance).
- Competitors (OpenAI + Anthropic) offering simpler hosted options may undercut price/time to value.

Next communications: follow-up email scheduled after finance update (TBD), send hosted pilot proposal and compact security checklist. Mark as "monitor — re-engage in Q3" if no change by 2026-06-30.
